fact: The SNSN 2023-2026 states the first strategy was approved by the Council of Ministers on 6 May 2020, that the ASIN was created in 2022, and that bjCSIRT handled 12, 17, 62 and 38 digital security incidents in 2020 to 2023.
title: Stratégie Nationale de Sécurité Numérique 2023-2026
publisher: Agence des Systèmes d'Information et du Numérique (ASIN)
